notes.subject: גל עיני
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'uncover my eyes' rendered 'skraumap ol ai bilong mi' — literal picture of removing a cover from the eyes

notes.subject: prayer to Yahwe
notes.rationale: Verse is direct address to Yahwe in second person ('ai bilong mi', 'Tora bilong yu')

notes.subject: mirakel
notes.rationale: נפלאות literally 'things separated/distinct, wonders' — rendered with borrowed 'mirakel'

translation: Skraumap ol ai bilong mi, na bai mi lukim ⟨olgeta⟩ ol mirakel we i kamap long Tora bilong yu.
